length_definition.unit: covered length (ns); frame count same as L01/L02, but the window is the last L/0.1+1 frames ending at the origin frame 10
length_definition.note: Length 0 = frame 10 only; 0.1 ns = frames 9-10; ...; 1.0 ns = frames 0-10 (identical to the L condition, used for the premise check). In L the window was frames 0..(L/0.1) paired with origin frame 10, leaving a time gap for short lengths.

base.name: K06(b) strong base: frozen T1I2006 + HistGBM sidecar (160 iters, lr 0.065, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf 20, L2 0.15, seed 20261121), trained on 8 calibration proteins, evaluated on 100 unseen proteins x 3 replicas

bootstrap_note: Within each resample, static-only, full-history and adjacent-mean AUPRCs are recomputed and the gain and recovery are recomputed inside the sample. Models are not refit; per-candidate predicted probabilities are resampled. Pooled AUPRC uses a numpy implementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (threshold-grouped), verified against sklearn to <1e-9 on the full test set for every condition and horizon. Macro AUPRC within a resample is the multiplicity-weighted mean of per-protein AUPRCs over proteins whose AUPRC is defined.
